testing-inspection-certification-value-c.name: Calibration & Metrology
testing-inspection-certification-value-c.description: The DACH calibration & metrology value chain covers accredited (DAkkS/Akkreditierung Austria/SAS, ISO 17025) and factory calibration of measuring/test equipment plus statutory legal metrology (Eichung under MessEG/MessEV). Demand is recurring and largely mandatory, driven by quality-system requirements (ISO 9001/IATF 16949 Prüfmittelüberwachung), the 2-year Eichfrist for trade instruments, and worker-safety inspection cycles, in a market of hundreds of owner-operated labs and service firms with no dominant consolidator.

testing-inspection-certification-value-c.name: Accredited calibration laboratories (DAkkS/ISO 17025, fixed-lab)
testing-inspection-certification-value-c.description: Independent and manufacturer-owned laboratories accredited to DIN EN ISO/IEC 17025 that calibrate industrial measuring and test equipment across defined measurands, issuing internationally recognised DAkkS certificates for customers' Prüfmittelüberwachung.

rationale.recurring: Prüfmittel must be re-calibrated on fixed intervals (typ. 1-3 yrs) under ISO 9001/IATF 16949, so the same instruments return repeatedly; largest lab (Perschmann) runs >3,000 calibrations/day.
rationale.fragmentation: Hundreds of accredited scopes range from large independents (Perschmann, esz AG) to many niche single-measurand labs; no single player dominates.
rationale.compliance: DAkkS accreditation and traceability to national standards (PTB) are prerequisites for regulated/audited industries, though the buying driver is often the customer QMS rather than a direct law.
